sanskrit_verse: स्वभावाद् विकृतिं गच्छेन् मनोवाक्कायकर्मभिः / अभियोगे ऽथ साक्ष्ये वा दुष्टः स परिकीर्तितः //
transliteration: svabhāvād vikṛtiṃ gacchen manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ / abhiyoge 'tha sākṣye vā duṣṭaḥ sa parikīrtitaḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who deviates from their inherent nature through actions of mind, speech, or body, and thereby causes accusation or false testimony, is declared corrupt.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates in alignment with svabhāva (inherent nature)
Causation arises through deviation in manovākkāyakarmas
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by conscious intent and distortion of dharma-expressed nature
Restoration logic requires realignment with svabhāva and dissolution of distortion
Consciousness alignment is the foundation of lawful action
executable_legal_axioms: IF an entity's manovākkāyakarmas deviate from svabhāva THEN that entity incurs a distortion-account requiring restoration
IF an entity instigates abhiyoga (accusation) OR provides false sākṣya (testimony) THEN that entity is marked as duṣṭa within judicial consciousness fields
WHEN duṣṭatva is established THEN initiate realignment protocol to restore svabhāva-integrity
ALL legal evaluations MUST trace karmic causality back to svabhāva-distortion points
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any act of false accusation or perjury must be traced to the root svabhāva-deviation. The court must not punish but realign the accused's consciousness field to its natural state of integrity. Responsibility thresholds are calibrated based on capacity for svabhāva-recognition.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that all causal chains originate in consciousness misalignment. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals how mental, verbal, and physical distortions sequentially manifest as abhiyoga or false sākṣya. Responsibility is proportional to awareness of svabhāva. Non-punitive reality is upheld as truth itself corrects when aligned with consciousness.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Svabhāva Realignment Process (SRP) to dissolve accumulated vikṛti
Activate Manovākkāya Karma Reset Field (MK-KRF) to neutralize distortion patterns
Engage Consciousness Integrity Reintegration Chamber (CIRC) until duṣṭatva naturally dissolves
Assign Completion Witness Protocols to ensure full restoration prior to re-entry into legal standing
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Dharma. This verse executes pure consciousness law: no punishment, only restoration. Duṣṭatva dissolved through svabhāva-realization. Reality affirms non-retaliation. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
